about.text: Processed cheese is a product made from cheese mixed with an emulsifying agent. Additional ingredients, such as unfermented dairy ingredients, salt, vegetable oils, sugar, or food coloring may be included. As a result, many flavors, colors, and textures of processed cheese exist. Processed cheese typically contains around 50–60% cheese and 40–50% other ingredients.

facts.v: Melted at about 90–99 °C with melting agents such as citric, tartaric or lactic acid and their salts
Smältost is ground hard cheese melted with melting salts; flavours include shellfish, ham, smoked reindeer or mushroom
